question: The full form of BIOS is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basic Input/Output System**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of BIOS is **Basic Input/Output System**.
 
• BIOS is a fundamental component in computers, serving as the interface between the computer's firmware and its operating system.
 
• It is responsible for booting up the computer and initiating hardware components before handing control over to the operating system.
 
• BIOS is stored on a small memory chip on the motherboard, known as the ROM (Read-Only Memory).
 
• BIOS settings can be configured through the BIOS setup utility, which can be accessed during the computer's boot process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term BIOS was first used by Gary Kildall in 1975 in the CP/M operating system.
 
• Modern computers have moved towards UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) as a replacement for the traditional BIOS, offering more features and better security.
 
• Despite the advent of UEFI, the term BIOS is still widely used and understood in the context of computer firmware.
 
• BIOS updates can be performed to fix bugs, add new features, or support new hardware components.
 
• Incorrect BIOS settings or failed BIOS updates can result in hardware malfunction or failure to boot the computer.
